name: blender_execute_code
description: DANGEROUS: run Python in the attached Blender (bpy), given as code or as a script file (path). Assign a JSON-able dict to `result`; print() output is returned. A run that changes the scene is one undo step; a failing one is undone. Every run asks permission. Prefer blender_apply.

path.description: A .py file to run instead of code, read as is (absolute or relative to the project): long scripts, no escaping.
